title: Diagnose the gap
statement_md:
`diagnose` reads a train/test pair and names the disease. Both errors lie in `[0, 1]`.

- both `>= high` -> `"underfit"`
- train `< high` and `test - train > gap` -> `"overfit"`
- otherwise -> `"good"`

The starter computes the gap as `train - test`, so it can never see an overfitting gap. Fix the sign without changing the signature.
starter:
def diagnose(train_error, test_error, high=0.3, gap=0.1):
    """Return 'underfit', 'overfit', or 'good' from two error levels."""
    if train_error >= high and test_error >= high:
        return "underfit"
    if train_error < high and train_error - test_error > gap:  # BUG: gap sign
        return "overfit"
    return "good"
mutations: return 'underfit' if a[0] > a[2] and a[1] > a[2] else ('overfit' if a[0] < a[2] and a[1] - a[0] > a[3] else 'good')
return 'underfit' if a[0] >= a[2] and a[1] >= a[2] else ('overfit' if a[1] > a[0] else 'good')
